description: This file defines functions and a plugin registration for interacting with Feishu wiki spaces and nodes, including listing, creating, moving, renaming, and retrieving wiki nodes, as well as registering a tool for these actions within a plugin API.

methods.name: listSpaces
methods.description: Lists all wiki spaces accessible via the provided client, returning space details and a hint if no spaces are found.

methods.name: listNodes
methods.description: Lists nodes within a specified wiki space, optionally filtered by a parent node token.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific wiki node by its token.

methods.name: createNode
methods.description: Creates a new wiki node within a specified space, with optional object type and parent node.

methods.name: moveNode
methods.description: Moves a wiki node to a different space or parent node.

methods.name: registerFeishuWikiTools
methods.description: Registers Feishu wiki tools with the plugin API, enabling actions like listing spaces, nodes, and managing wiki nodes.
